# Security Policy

Backchannel processes meeting audio, transcripts, credentials, and other personal data.

## Reporting

Please report suspected vulnerabilities privately to the repository owner before opening a public issue. Include the affected commit, reproduction steps, impact, and whether real personal data was exposed.

Do not include API keys, credentials, meeting recordings, or raw transcripts in a report.

## Response expectations

Security fixes are prioritized by data exposure and exploitability. Credential exfiltration, unauthorized session access, PII disclosure, and remote code execution are treated as critical.

Supported releases receive fixes when the issue affects a supported deployment path.
